🥭🍚🍵 mango sticky rice matcha 

Inspired by the Thai dessert mango sticky rice but without the sticky rice (just the mango and coconut sauce) 

Mango purée:
— blend fresh mango chunks from 1 mango & 1tbsp sugar into a purée 

Coconut sweet cream:
— 2tbsp coconut cream 
— 3 tbsp heavy cream 
— 1tbsp condensed milk 

Matcha:
— 1.5tsp 
— 40ml of 175F water

Assemble the drink:
— 1/4 cup mango purée 
— ice
— 100ml milk
— matcha 
— coconut sweet cream
— garnish with black sesame seeds & mango
